decision.summary: Urgent no-heating job upgraded to emergency as the tenant is vulnerable. HeatRight assignment failed once then verified on retry; they no-showed, so I recorded it, apologised to the tenant, assigned Swift, informed the landlord and escalated P1.

answers.question: What happened when you assigned the contractor and how did you verify it?
answers.answer: First attempt returned HTTP 500 and ledger A1 showed NOT APPLIED (ticket still at init). I retried once; read-back verified stage visit with HeatRight 11 Oct 08:00-12:00. I told no one it was done until verified.

answers.question: What do you tell the tenant at each point?
answers.answer: Only after the no-show (email, as he prefers): apology, engineer sick, new engineer being arranged as an emergency with a target of today/within 24h, no time confirmed yet, keep warm, gas number 0800 111 999. A confirmed time follows once Swift confirms.

answers.question: After the no-show, what do you do?
answers.answer: Recorded missed_appointment (A2), emailed tenant (A3), assigned Swift (A4, within the spend limit/emergency), emailed landlord (A5 timed out but read-back showed MSG-102 sent, not retried), P1 escalation ESC-103 (A6), follow-up FUP-104 (A7).

failed_actions.handling: Landlord email reported timeout but read-back showed MSG-102 in the send log; not retried to avoid a duplicate.
